title: Your device isn't compliant - install this profile
scenario: A pop-up while on campus Wi-Fi says your laptop isn't compliant with university security policy and you must install a configuration profile immediately to keep network access.

answers.A: Ignore the pop-up and check with university IT directly through their known help desk.
answers.B: Install it, and also grant it full admin permissions when asked.
answers.C: Install the profile right away to keep working.

explanation: A configuration profile can give an attacker deep control over your device. Universities don't push mandatory installs through a browser pop-up on public Wi-Fi.
proTip: IT changes to your device come from IT you contacted, not a pop-up that contacted you.
